description.zh-CN: 关闭后入口服务不再记录请求、采样和事件，网关本身不受影响。修改后需要重启入口服务。
description.en-US: When off, the entry stops recording requests, samples and events; the gateway itself is unaffected. A change needs the entry restarted.

description.zh-CN: 遥测数据库文件的位置，留空使用入口服务 data 目录下的 telemetry.sqlite。修改后需要重启入口服务。
description.en-US: Where the telemetry database file lives; empty uses telemetry.sqlite in the entry's data folder. A change needs the entry restarted.

description.zh-CN: 入口服务采集模型运行指标和显卡数据的间隔，单位毫秒，范围 5000 到 60000。
description.en-US: How often the entry samples runtime metrics and GPU data, in milliseconds, from 5000 to 60000.

description.zh-CN: 两个模型管理器各自统计吞吐量的采样间隔，单位毫秒。修改后需要重启两个管理器。
description.en-US: How often each model manager samples its own throughput statistics, in milliseconds. A change needs both managers restarted.

description.zh-CN: 按天汇总使用的时区，以相对 UTC 的分钟数表示，必须是整小时（例如东八区为 480）。
description.en-US: The time zone used for daily totals, as minutes from UTC; it must be a whole number of hours (480 is UTC+08:00).

title.zh-CN: 保留旧版访问日志文件

description.zh-CN: 继续把网关请求写入旧版的访问日志文件，供还在读取它的脚本使用；新页面不依赖它。
description.en-US: Keep writing gateway requests to the legacy access-log file for scripts that still read it. The new pages do not depend on it.

description.zh-CN: 遥测数据库超过这个大小（MB）时，会先清理较旧的请求明细和原始采样。
description.en-US: When the telemetry database grows past this size (MB), older request rows and raw samples are pruned first.

description.zh-CN: 一次导出最多包含的行数，超过的部分会被截断并在文件末尾标注。
description.en-US: The most rows one export holds; the rest is cut off and the file says so at its end.

description.zh-CN: 单条请求记录保留的天数，范围 7 到 365。更早的数据只留下汇总。
description.en-US: How many days single request rows are kept, from 7 to 365. Older data stays only as totals.

title.zh-CN: IP 与客户端信息保留时长
title.en-US: Keep IP and client info for

description.zh-CN: 请求记录里的 IP 和客户端标识保留的天数，不能超过请求明细保留天数；到期后会被打码。
description.en-US: How many days the address and client details of a request row are kept; it cannot exceed the request-row period. After that they are masked.

description.zh-CN: 每 10 秒一条的运行指标和显卡原始采样保留的小时数，范围 12 到 336。
description.en-US: How many hours the 10-second runtime and GPU samples are kept, from 12 to 336.

description.zh-CN: 按分钟汇总的数据保留的天数。
description.en-US: How many days the per-minute totals are kept.

description.zh-CN: 按小时汇总的数据保留的天数。按天汇总的数据永久保留。
description.en-US: How many days the hourly totals are kept. Daily totals are kept forever.

description.zh-CN: 一般事件保留的天数；启动、实例、容器、配置和封禁类事件永久保留。
description.en-US: How many days ordinary events are kept; launch, instance, container, configuration and ban events are kept forever.

description.zh-CN: 每千瓦时的电价；留空表示不计算电费，页面只显示用电量。
description.en-US: The price per kilowatt-hour; empty means no cost is calculated and the pages show energy only.

description.zh-CN: 电费显示的币种，三位大写字母代码（例如 CNY、USD）。
description.en-US: The currency of the electricity cost, a three-letter upper-case code such as CNY or USD.

description.zh-CN: 按本地时间划分的分时电价，每项包含起止时间和每千瓦时电价；时段可以跨过午夜，但不能互相重叠。
description.en-US: Time-of-use prices by local time, each with a start, an end and a price per kilowatt-hour. A window may cross midnight but windows may not overlap.

description.zh-CN: 显卡以外的整机固定功耗（瓦）。它只会加进用电量统计的总计里，并标注为“已配置的主机基础功耗”。
description.en-US: The constant power draw of the rest of the machine, in watts. It is added to the energy totals only, labelled as the configured host baseline.

description.zh-CN: 告警触发时推送到的地址列表，每项有编号、地址、消息格式和最低推送级别。签名密钥不保存在这里，而是单独存放在密钥库中。
description.en-US: Where alerts are pushed, each with an id, a URL, a message format and a minimum severity. Signing secrets are not kept here; they live in the secret store.
